_comment: Tripo's segmentation handed modelWeapon more than the drum: the front scoop plate, a fin and a scatter of shards came with it, so the whole assembly counter-rotated with the rotor. The drum itself is the compact mass around the pivot (0, 0.005, 0.251) — describe THAT and invert, because the debris is far easier to define by what it is not. The remainder becomes body geometry under modelBody.
